positions.name: RecordedDirectiveTerms
positions.frame: when a directive sets a mandate, how do the note's follow-on fields (cadence, owner) stand toward it — as independent claims or as a ratifying record of its terms?
positions.why: Both src-2 and src-3 share actor (Xena), act (assertive), and footing (animator/author Xena, no principal) — they are the note-taker's flat, matter-of-fact record of the two parameters (cadence, owner) that Quinton's directive in src-1 established. Dimensional reads converge: both sit in calm-positive affect, matter-of-fact register, authority-ranking (ratifying, not originating), informational power, decision conviction — a settled recording register distinct from src-1's directive-issuing, principle-level, antithesis-styled force. The tension the set holds: these are presented as plain facts, yet they only exist because src-1 mandated them — the frame reads them as ratification rather than negotiation.
